query_family: Jadarat (جدارات) / Taqat (طاقة) / HRDF / Tamheer (تمهير) national employment platforms
yield_note: Jadarat confirmed official but 403-blocked to automated fetch; Taqat confirmed legacy/superseded by Jadarat; HRDF itself is informational, not a job board.

query_family: PIF portfolio companies / Saudi Exchange (Tadawul) listed-company directory
yield_note: Both official domains (pif.gov.sa, saudiexchange.sa) returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch, consistent with the anti-bot pattern already documented in source-catalog.csv for Riyadh Chamber/Council of Saudi Chambers.

query_family: Chambers of commerce beyond existing Riyadh/Asharqia/Council rows
yield_note: Found new: Jeddah Chamber of Commerce (JCCI) and its Blue Pages business directory -- genuine new coverage for the Jeddah/Makkah region.

query_family: Saudi/Gulf job boards (وظائف السعودية / وظائف الرياض / وظائف جدة / وظائف الدمام / وظائف الخبر / وظائف مكة / وظائف المدينة / وظائف تبوك / وظائف نيوم / Saudi remote jobs / Saudi hybrid jobs)
yield_note: Found new: Mihnati.com, Wadhefa.com, Tanqeeb Saudi, GulfTalent Saudi-specific page. Diminishing returns after these -- further Arabic-board queries surfaced only aggregator roundup articles repeating the same names.
Found NADIA Global, Cooper Fitch, BAC Middle East as named real agencies; most operate a B2B model with client identity undisclosed and no public job board.

Checked international-remote.csv baseline; no dedicated new remote-platform source found beyond what other pilot directories already cover, so not duplicated here. Jobgether (Saudi-specific remote category pages) surfaced separately via the supplied-lead research pass and was added to discovered-job-sources.csv instead.

query_family: Company-specific ATS searches (Workday/Greenhouse/Lever/SmartRecruiters/Workable/Ashby/Oracle/SAP SuccessFactors/Taleo) for supplied LinkedIn employer leads
approx_queries_run: 146 (one verification pass per non-deterministic supplied lead across two parallel research batches)
yield_note: Primary method for classifying the 155 supplied LinkedIn leads: per-company WebSearch/WebFetch to identify official domain + ATS/careers channel. Batch1 (73 leads) verification was WebSearch-snippet-based; Batch2 (73 leads, with 1 gap-filled directly) combined WebSearch with direct WebFetch confirmation for higher-confidence rows. See supplied-linkedin-leads.csv for per-lead evidence.

query_family: Domain/company-identity research for supplied HR/recruitment email leads
yield_note: Per-domain WebSearch/WebFetch to confirm company identity, Saudi presence, and first-party evidence that the specific mailbox is used for recruitment (not just that the domain is real). See supplied-hr-email-audit.csv. Session WebSearch budget (200 calls) was exhausted near the end of this family; the final ~15 domains relied on WebFetch only or on identity already established earlier in the same pass.

query_family: Saudi AZM / HUMAIN / Master Works / GESMA / Star / Wonderful / THE-TEAM / Systems Arabia disambiguation follow-ups
yield_note: Targeted follow-up searches for generic-sounding or ambiguous supplied names; most confirmed no identifiable distinct real entity (kept at insufficient_evidence rather than guessed). Master Works specifically hit the exhausted session WebSearch budget and returned only unrelated results via a fallback WebFetch.
